description: Native search-override child-continuation recovery audit. Start from the child target-only fit and distill broad behavior back toward the previous recovered model while retaining child-continuation targets.

metadata.final_recovery_result: The final recovery model retained target fit with exact .pt/.nn parity: 1064/1400 top1 and 1346/1400 top3, with final broad drift around 105cp. Corrected native-32 10k search rejected it against the parent: top1 425/1409, compare 181 candidate-better vs 717 parent-better, capped -65161.
metadata.diagnosis: On the unified corpus the exported model itself reached 682/1409 top1, but Enyo search followed the model root move on only 442/1409. In the model_top1_search_override subset, parent was better 345 times vs 9 candidate-better, so root-only training is not enough.
metadata.targets: runs/native-searchaware-override-child-targets-20260525/override_child_targets.jsonl: 160 child positions from the worst model-top1/search-override cases, scored at 50k nodes per legal move and built with max_moves=16.
metadata.targetonly_result: native-searchaware-override-child-targetonly-lr1e6-e120 fit the child-continuation corpus with exact .pt/.nn parity: 151/160 top1, 158/160 top3, sum_gap=23, worst_gap=6.
metadata.hypothesis: A recovered child-continuation model may keep enough of the target-only child signal to stop search from overriding the static root preference, while broad distillation prevents the target-only drift from becoming a non-candidate.
metadata.gate: Recovery audit only. Exported .pt/.nn model gate must retain at least 130/160 top1 on override_child_targets before any corrected native-32 10k engine gate is considered.
metadata.decision: If target retention passes, run only a corrected native-32 10k gate against the original parent reference CSV. If 10k fails, close child-continuation recovery or rebuild a broader child corpus; no SPRT.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must retain at least 130/160 top1 on the override-child corpus with exact .pt/.nn parity.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Run corrected native-32 search_target_gate with --require-native-net-load on the unified corpus at 10k nodes, reusing the original parent reference.csv.
validation.hard_stop: No SPRT unless corrected 10k and then 300k gates beat the original parent.
